title: UI critique (Medium): Plain-dark primary button contrast 2.45:1 (pre-existing)
description: White text on the Plain-dark primary #64a8ff measures ~2.45:1, below WCAG AA. Predates the palette work; the plan puts it out of repair scope but requires it recorded. Screenshot: docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/screens/browser-writing-dark-plain.png. Suggested (owner decision): adopt --accent-fill #0074E8 for filled primaries in Plain dark, or accept and document.

review.note: Approved as 'recorded, not fixed': Plain must stay today's look per the plan; the contrast gap is documented in CRITIQUE.md and docs/design-system.md; fixing it is an owner decision (option: Plain dark .primary uses a darker fill such as #0074e8 with white text). No code change verified by git status.
